name: Super Golden Spins

features.name: Nine-line 3×3 grid
features.description: A small classic-style grid where three-symbol combinations on nine lines pay up to 700x.

features.name: Twin prize wheels
features.description: Three scatters spin two wheels at once, one awarding cash up to 100x and the other multipliers up to 27x.

features.name: Combined outcomes
features.description: Cash results are added, while multipliers boost the cash value or multiply each other before applying to the bet.

review:
A compact retro neon 3x3 with nine lines, where three-symbol line wins can pay up to 700x – the main grid does more work than in most modern games.

Three scatters start the wheel bonus: two wheels spin together, one with cash values up to 100x, the other with multipliers up to 27x. Two cash results add, cash plus multiplier combine, and two multipliers multiply each other. 96.55% RTP. Short, simple sessions with one clear target.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
